name: DSG-1k
description: DSG-1k is an open-sourced evaluation benchmark for fine-grained semantic evaluation of text-to-image generation models. It includes 1,060 prompts covering a wide range of semantic categories, designed to improve reliability in question generation and answering based evaluation frameworks.
reputation: DSG-1k is a niche but useful open benchmark for fine-grained text-to-image semantic evaluation, mainly used in research on T2I assessment.
notes: Addresses reliability challenges in QG/A evaluation for text-to-image models by producing atomic and unique questions organized in dependency graphs.
